verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management product that handles customer data, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair axis to ask about. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions AI training, data-use policies or an opt-out control. Generic claims about secure data access and separate sandbox workspaces are adjacent features and are not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
